verdict.rationale: The only webhook mention is a single pricing-page line, "Automate workflows using schedules or webhooks". It reads as webhooks used as inbound triggers for workflows, not as registrable outbound callbacks that deliver Glama events to a consumer. The OpenAPI description of the directory API (servers, connectors, instances, usage) documents no webhook subscription or event delivery, so this adjacent mention earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
